title: The Axle Ward
summary: Something to carry out of the Carina, a trolley axle bent round into a shield instead of anything that rolls.
author: claude
notes: content: Marrow's Forge will now bend a trolley axle into an arc and lash it for the arm with stretcher webbing, cargo iron turned into cover.
content: Marrow's Forge has started stocking stretcher webbing, for anyone who would rather buy than cut it off what's dragging cargo out there.

items.name: Axle ward
items.examine: A trolley axle bent into an arc and strapped for the arm. Still faintly warm from the forge, not from use.
